response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backend systems, plus strong community/mentoring signals (workshops, courses, open-source tooling). However, the role's hard requirement of 8 years of C++ is not close to being met — the resume shows roughly six months of C/C++ work at National Instruments and a university thesis project, with the professional core being TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. Similarly, there is no evidence of building or leading an internal cloud compute platform, large-scale infrastructure ownership, or a formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. The Sociomantic low-latency microservices work and Kubernetes-deployable GISCollective platform are the closest adjacencies but fall short of the scale and depth implied by the job description.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ yrs) with strong testing/TDD and craftsmanship culture
Proven low-latency distributed systems work at Sociomantic (millions of req/s, async I/O, caching)
Clear mentoring/knowledge-sharing track record: workshops, conference talks, courses, OSS tooling
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~6 months professional)
No demonstrated cloud compute platform ownership or large-scale infrastructure architecture
No formal technical lead role with project prioritization/roadmap responsibility

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud/compute platform and technical leadership experience
High-throughput distributed systems and mentoring background
